data.gender_notes: Roderic is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic 'Rothari' or 'Hrodric', Roderic means 'famous ruler'. The name was borne by various European monarchs and saints throughout history. The name Roderic carries the meaning “Famous ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Roderic usually hope their child will grow to embody famous ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Roderic belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Famous ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roderic total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Roderic carries an air of nobility and power, with its historical ties to European monarchs. It is a name that instantly evokes a sense of leadership and authority, making it a popular choice for characters in literature, media, and even in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Roderic can be found in its root meaning - 'ruling with God's power'. This name serves as a reminder that no matter our position in life, we are all called to rule with God's guidance and grace. It is a powerful reminder of the importance of humility, faith, and obedience to God's will, as we seek to rule our own lives and make a positive impact in the world around us.
